hints.title: Which module can go first?
hints.body: A module with no unmet prerequisites can be built immediately. What happens to the prerequisites of the modules that depend on it after it is built?

hints.title: Count incoming dependencies
hints.body: Store how many prerequisites each module still has. Put every module with a count of zero into a queue as buildable.

hints.title: Remove modules one at a time
hints.body: Pop a buildable module, count it, and decrement the count for each module that depends on it. When a dependent's count reaches zero, add it to the queue. If the final count is less than `numModules`, a cycle blocked the rest.

hints.title: Pseudocode
hints.body:
```
indegree = array of zeros of length numModules
next = adjacency list for each module
for [a, b] in prerequisites:
    next[b].append(a)
    indegree[a] += 1
queue = all modules with indegree 0
built = 0
while queue is not empty:
    module = queue.pop()
    built += 1
    for dependent in next[module]:
        indegree[dependent] -= 1
        if indegree[dependent] == 0: queue.push(dependent)
return built == numModules
```

This is pseudocode, not a complete solution. Duplicate pairs still need to be counted consistently.
